description: Calling a name that a namespace with other functions lacks is an error
notes: The spec has no namespaced function names, so ns::g() would be a syntax error. hashicorp/hcl parses the call (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go), and because the function table has another function in the namespace ns, it reports that ns has no function g (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
reference_error: There is no function named "g" in namespace ns::
